The NVIDIA H200 and H100 support granular power management by using the Total Graphics Power (TGP)
setting. This setting determines what the maximum power each GPU can use, and in turn will dictate how
many nodes can be installed in the enclosure and how hot the inlet water can be to properly cool all nodes.
Lenovo supports pre-set TGP of 500W, 600W and 700W. With full 350W processor confgi uration and the
GPUs at 700W up to 40°C system inlet water temperature can be supported based on 4 lpm fol w rate per
tray. With the GPUs set to 600W, 45°C inlet water is supported. The supported trays per chassis are shown
in the Power supplies section.
